newsitem.title: USA: Cronkite leaves N.Y. hospital after heart surgery.
newsitem.headline: Cronkite leaves N.Y. hospital after heart surgery.

text.p: Retired CBS News anchorman Walter Cronkite left a New York hospital on Wednesday more than a week after successful quadruple heart bypass surgery, the network said.

Cronkite, who retired as the anchorman for the CBS Evening News in 1981 after 17 years, returned to his New York home after leaving New York Hospital-Cornell Medical Centre, said his CBS assistant Julie Sukman.

"They say all my numbers are great, that the operation was a complete, total success," the 80-year-old Cronkite told reporters outside the hospital. "I am absolutely delighted obviously with the service here, I'm getting out just nine days after checking in."
Cronkite, who developed a reputation as the "most trusted man in America" during his long career as an anchorman, underwent the surgery on April 1.
